method.method_draft: First describe the map position: find the label ③ and note that it lies in the northern/eastern part of the mapped area, around 35°N or farther north. Then apply the climate rule that northern China at these latitudes has cold winters with temperatures below 0°C. Since river water can freeze when winter temperatures remain below 0°C, conclude that rivers in ③ have a freezing period: 有结冰期。
